title: For MY Market: Key Attributes Become Mandatory for Selected Hi-Po Categories
content:
## Summary Malaysia will roll out mandatory key attributes for selected hi-po categories in **30 September, 2026**. For Health, Sports & Outdoor, and Tools & Hardware, selected attributes will change from **optional** to **required**. For Household Appliances, TikTok Shop will add a new structured attribute, **Energy Efficiency Star Rating**, and require it for relevant products. This is a category configuration update that affects seller-center and partner-powered product creation flows. ## What is changing? | Area | Change | | --- | --- | | Health | Selected key attributes will become required during product creation. | | Sports & Outdoor | Selected key attributes will become required during product creation. | | Tools &Hardware | Selected key attributes will become required during product creation. | | Household Appliances | A new structured attribute, Energy Efficiency Star Rating, will be added and required for relevant products. | This update is intended to improve structured product data completeness and support better search, filtering, product navigation, and recommendation quality. ## Which markets are affected? **Malaysia (MY)** only. ## Which categories are affected? * Health * Sports & Outdoor * Tools & Hardware * Household Appliances ## Detailed attribute scope The following details can help partners, ISVs, ERPs, and API integrators update attribute mapping, validation, and listing logic for the MY rollout. ### Health — Optional to required This change covers **15 L3 categories** and **4 attributes**. | Attribute | L2 scope | L3 coverage | Applicable L3 categories | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Health Benefits | Nutrition & Wellness | 3 L3s | Beauty Supplement / Fitness Supplements / Vitamins, Minerals & Wellness Supplements | | Product Form | Nutrition & Wellness; OTC Medications & Treatments
| 13 L3s total | **Nutrition & Wellness (4)**: Beauty Supplement / Fitness Supplements / Vitamins, Minerals & Wellness Supplements / Weight Management Supplements
**OTC Medications & Treatments (9)**: Allergies, Sinus & Asthma / Antifungals / Baby & Child Medicine / Coughs & Colds / Cuts & Wounds / Digestion & Nausea / Eczema, Psoriasis & Rosacea Care / Pain Relief / Scars & Stretchmarks | | Item Type | Medical Supplies | 2 L3s | First Aid Supplies / Pill Dispensers | | Medicine Type | OTC Medications & Treatments | 1 L3 | Baby & Child Medicine | ### Sports & Outdoor — Optional to required This change covers **4 L3 categories** and **4 attributes**. | Attribute | L2 scope | L3 coverage | Applicable L3 category | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Shuttlecocks Type | Ball Sports | 1 L3 | Badminton | | Fitness Machine Type | Fitness | 1 L3 | Exercise Machines | | Clothing Type | Sport & Outdoor Clothing | 1 L3 | Sport Thermal Underwear | | Bra Style | Sport & Outdoor Clothing | 1 L3 | Sports Bras | ### Tools & Hardware — Optional to required This change covers **40 L3 categories** and **2 attributes**. | Attribute | L2 scope | L3 coverage | Applicable L3 categories | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Warranty Duration | Power Tools; Garden Tools | 20 L3s total | **Power Tools (16)**: Air Compressors / Angle Grinders / Blowers / Electric Drills / Electric Saws / Electric Screwdrivers / Electric Wrenches / Glue Guns / Heat Guns / Nail Guns / Polishers / Power Tool Sets / Pressure Washers / Specialty Power Tools / Spray Guns / Wood Routers
**Garden Tools (4)**: Chainsaws / Grass Trimmers / Lawn Mowers / Leaf Blowers & Vacuums | | Warranty Type | Hand Tools; Hardware; Garden Tools; Power Tools; Soldering Equipment; Tool Organizers; Measuring Tools | 20 L3s total | **Hand Tools (6)**: Axes / Chisels / Hammers / Saws / Tool Kits / Wrenches
**Hardware (3)**: Clamps / Furniture Hardware / Window Hardware
**Garden Tools (3)**: Garden Cleaning Tools / Gardening Gloves & Protective Gear / Pruning Tools
**Power Tools (1)**: Power Tool Accessories
**Soldering Equipment (3)**: Soldering Stations / Welders / Welding Accessories
**Tool Organizers (3)**: Tool Bags / Tool Cases & Boxes / Tool Racks & Bars
**Measuring Tools (1)**: Hand Measuring Tools | ### Household Appliances — New attribute plus required enforcement This change covers **8 L3 categories** and **1 new attribute**. | Attribute | L2 scope | L3 coverage | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Energy Efficiency Star Rating | Large Home Appliances | 8 L3s | **New attribute**: this field does not exist on the platform today and requires a new attribute creation flow before required enforcement. The scope includes categories such as Air Conditioner, Refrigerators, TVs, and Washing Machines & Dryers. | ## Who is affected? * Partners, ISVs, and ERPs that create or update MY product listings. * API integrators that submit product data for sellers in the affected MY categories. * MY sellers using partner tools or direct API-based listing flows. ## Which version is applicable? No separate OpenAPI version change is specified in the PRD. This is a **category configuration rollout** for MY and will apply when the change goes live in **30 September, 2026.** ## What action is required? * Review your MY product creation and product update flows for the affected categories. * Make sure your integrations can populate all newly required attributes before submitting products. * Add support for Energy Efficiency Star Rating in Household Appliances. * Validate request handling, field mapping, and submission logic before the final rollout date. * Watch for the final merchant announcement and cutover timeline before switching production traffic.
